name: French Onion Soup (Lightened, No Bread)
steps: Cook thinly sliced onions in oil and butter over medium-low heat 40 minutes until deeply caramelized.
Add garlic, thyme and wine; reduce; add broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Ladle into ovenproof bowls, top with Swiss cheese and broil until bubbling.

name: Cauliflower Leek Vichyssoise
steps: Sweat leeks in oil 6 minutes without browning.
Add cauliflower and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend with milk and vinegar; chill or serve warm with chives.

name: Chicken Enchilada Soup
steps: Sauté onion and pepper in oil with cumin.
Add enchilada sauce, broth, chiles and chicken; simmer 20 minutes; shred chicken.
Add beans; serve with cheddar, yogurt and cilantro.

name: Lentil & Sausage Stew
steps: Brown sausage; add onion, carrot and garlic 5 minutes; add paprika.
Add lentils, tomatoes and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in spinach and vinegar.

name: Chilled Cucumber Avocado Soup
steps: Blend cucumber, avocado, yogurt, lime, dill, garlic, water and salt until smooth.
Chill 1 hour.
Drizzle with olive oil before serving.

name: Turkey Kale White Bean Soup
steps: Brown turkey with onion and carrot in oil; add garlic and rosemary.
Add broth and beans; simmer 15 minutes.
Add kale for 5 minutes; serve with parmesan.

name: Cabbage Roll Soup
steps: Brown beef and onion in oil; add garlic and paprika.
Add tomatoes, sauce, broth and cabbage; simmer 25 minutes.
Add cauliflower rice for 5 minutes; finish with dill.

name: Cod & Vegetable Stew
steps: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic with paprika in oil 6 minutes; add wine.
Add tomatoes, broth, chickpeas, kale; simmer 12 minutes.
Add cod chunks; cook 6 minutes; finish with parsley.

name: Spinach & Egg White Soup
steps: Simmer broth with ginger, garlic and tamari.
Drizzle in egg whites while stirring.
Add spinach, sesame oil and green onion.

name: Chicken Barley Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, mushrooms in oil 6 minutes; add garlic and thyme.
Add broth and chicken; simmer 25 minutes; shred chicken.
Stir in cooked barley; finish with parsley.

name: Golden Turmeric Chicken Soup
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, celery in oil with turmeric, ginger and garlic.
Add broth and chicken; simmer 20 minutes; shred.
Add cauliflower rice 5 minutes; finish with lemon, parsley, pepper.

name: Italian Sausage & Zucchini Soup
steps: Brown sausage; add onion and garlic.
Add tomatoes, broth and zucchini; simmer 12 minutes.
Stir in spinach; serve with parmesan.

name: Tofu Vegetable Ramen (Shirataki)
steps: Simmer broth with ginger, garlic, tamari and shiitake 8 minutes; add bok choy 2 minutes.
Rinse shirataki well and add to bowls with pan-seared tofu.
Whisk miso into broth off heat; pour over; top with halved eggs, green onion, sesame oil, nori.

name: Turkey Pumpkin Chili
steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper in oil; add garlic and spices.
Add pumpkin, tomatoes, beans, broth; simmer 30 minutes.
Season; serve with yogurt and pepitas.

name: Seafood & Fennel Broth
steps: Sauté fennel, leek and garlic in oil 6 minutes; add wine.
Add broth and tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes.
Add cod and shrimp 5 minutes; finish with parsley and lemon.

name: Lemon Herb Grilled Chicken Breast
steps: Marinate chicken in lemon, oil, garlic, herbs, salt and pepper 15 minutes.
Grill 6–7 minutes per side until 165°F; rest 5 minutes.
Serve with steamed broccoli and quinoa.

name: Sheet Pan Chicken Fajitas
steps: Toss sliced chicken, peppers and onion with oil and spices on a sheet pan.
Roast at 425°F for 20 minutes, stirring once.
Squeeze lime over; serve in warm tortillas with yogurt and cilantro.

name: Chicken Stir-Fry with Broccoli & Cashews
steps: Toss sliced chicken with arrowroot and half the tamari.
Stir-fry chicken in avocado oil until golden; remove. Stir-fry broccoli, pepper, garlic, ginger 4 minutes.
Return chicken with remaining tamari, vinegar and sesame oil; toss with cashews and green onion.

name: Baked Chicken Parmesan (Almond Crust)
steps: Pound chicken thin; dip in egg then almond flour mixed with half the parmesan and seasoning.
Bake on an oiled sheet at 425°F 15 minutes; top with marinara and mozzarella; bake 8 more minutes.
Serve over sautéed zoodles with basil and remaining parmesan.

name: Greek Chicken Skewers with Tzatziki
steps: Marinate chicken cubes in lemon, oil, garlic, oregano and salt 20 minutes; thread onto skewers.
Grill 10–12 minutes, turning.
Mix yogurt with grated squeezed cucumber, dill and garlic for tzatziki; serve with tomatoes and onion.

name: Slow Cooker Salsa Chicken
steps: Place chicken, salsa and spices in a slow cooker; cook on low 4 hours.
Shred chicken in the sauce; stir in beans.
Serve over romaine with avocado, cheddar and yogurt.

name: Chicken Cacciatore
steps: Brown chicken in oil; remove. Sauté onion, pepper, mushrooms 6 minutes; add garlic and herbs.
Deglaze with wine; add tomatoes, olives, capers; return chicken.
Simmer covered 30 minutes; serve with sautéed greens or cauliflower rice.

name: Turkey Meatballs in Marinara over Zoodles
steps: Mix turkey, egg, parmesan, almond flour, garlic, parsley, seasoning and salt; form 16 meatballs.
Brown in oil, add marinara and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve over lightly sautéed zoodles.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala (Yogurt Sauce)
steps: Marinate chicken in half the yogurt with half the spices 20 minutes; broil 8 minutes.
Sauté onion, ginger, garlic and remaining spices in oil; add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Add coconut milk, remaining yogurt and chicken; simmer 8 minutes. Serve over cauliflower rice with cilantro.

name: Buffalo Chicken Lettuce Wraps
steps: Toss shredded chicken with hot sauce and melted butter.
Mix yogurt and blue cheese.
Fill lettuce leaves with chicken, celery, carrot and blue cheese sauce.

name: Chicken Piccata
steps: Pound chicken thin, season, dust with almond flour and sear in oil 4 minutes per side; remove.
Add garlic, broth, lemon and capers; simmer 3 minutes; whisk in butter.
Return chicken to coat; serve with steamed green beans and parsley.

name: Chicken & Vegetable Curry
steps: Fry curry paste in oil 1 minute; add chicken and brown 5 minutes.
Add coconut milk, broth and vegetables; simmer 15 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and lime; top with basil; serve with a small portion of brown rice.

name: Herb Roasted Whole Chicken with Vegetables
ing: 1 whole chicken ~1.6 kg, skin removed after roasting
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F. Rub chicken with oil, herbs, salt; stuff with lemon and garlic.
Roast on a bed of carrots and onion 60 minutes; add sprouts for the last 25 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes; carve, removing most skin, and serve with the vegetables.

name: Chicken Shawarma Bowls
steps: Marinate chicken in spices, garlic, lemon, oil 15 minutes; roast at 425°F 20 minutes; slice.
Sauté cauliflower rice; whisk tahini with yogurt, lemon and water.
Bowl cauliflower rice, chicken, cucumber, tomato, sauce and parsley.

name: Turkey Burgers with Avocado (Lettuce Bun)
steps: Mix turkey with grated onion, garlic, Dijon, egg and salt; form 4 patties.
Grill or pan-sear in oil 6–7 minutes per side to 165°F.
Serve in lettuce leaves with avocado, tomato and red onion.

name: Chicken Marsala with Mushrooms
steps: Pound chicken, season, sear in oil 4 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté mushrooms and shallot 6 minutes; add garlic, wine, broth, thyme; reduce by half; swirl in butter.
Return chicken 3 minutes; serve with roasted asparagus and parsley.

name: Pesto Chicken Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve and seed peppers; roast cut-side down at 400°F 10 minutes.
Mix chicken, pesto, cauliflower rice, chopped tomato, spinach and half the mozzarella.
Fill peppers, top with remaining cheese; bake 20 minutes.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Bowl (No-Sugar Sauce)
steps: Whisk tamari, vinegar, ginger, garlic, sweetener, sesame oil and arrowroot with 60 ml water.
Sear chicken in avocado oil 8 minutes; add sauce and simmer until glossy.
Serve over brown rice with steamed broccoli and carrot; top with sesame and green onion.

name: Chicken Enchiladas (Low-Carb Tortillas)
steps: Mix chicken, beans, chiles, onion, half the cheese and a third of the sauce.
Fill and roll tortillas; place seam-side down in a baking dish; pour over remaining sauce and cheese.
Bake at 375°F 20 minutes; serve with yogurt and cilantro.

name: Spatchcock Lemon Pepper Chicken
steps: Remove backbone and flatten chicken; rub with oil, lemon zest, pepper, garlic, thyme and salt.
Roast at 450°F 40–45 minutes to 165°F; add green beans and tomatoes to the pan for the last 15 minutes.
Rest, carve and serve, removing skin.

name: Chicken Lettuce Wraps (PF Chang's Style)
steps: Brown chicken in avocado oil; add garlic, ginger, mushrooms, water chestnuts 4 minutes.
Add tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, sriracha; cook 2 minutes; stir in green onion.
Spoon into lettuce cups.

name: Coconut Lime Chicken Thighs
steps: Sear seasoned chicken in oil 4 minutes per side.
Add coconut milk, lime juice, garlic, ginger, jalapeño; simmer covered 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach; serve over cauliflower rice with cilantro and lime zest.

name: Chicken Cobb Bowl Meal Prep
steps: Grill chicken and slice; boil eggs; crisp bacon.
Divide romaine, tomatoes, chicken, eggs, bacon and blue cheese into 4 containers.
Pack dressing (oil, vinegar, Dijon) and avocado separately; add before eating.

name: Turkey Stuffed Zucchini Boats
steps: Halve zucchini lengthwise, scoop out centers and chop the flesh.
Brown turkey with onion, garlic, zucchini flesh and seasoning; stir in marinara.
Fill boats, top with cheeses; bake at 400°F 20 minutes.

name: Chicken Adobo (Filipino-Style)
steps: Brown chicken in oil; add onion and garlic.
Add tamari, vinegar, bay leaves and pepper with 150 ml water; simmer covered 35 minutes, uncovered the last 10 to reduce.
Serve with sautéed bok choy and cauliflower rice.

name: Almond-Crusted Chicken Tenders
steps: Cut chicken into strips; dip in egg then almond flour-parmesan-spice mix.
Bake on an oiled rack at 425°F 18 minutes, flipping once.
Mix yogurt and Dijon for dipping; serve with roasted broccoli.

name: Chicken & Broccoli Alfredo (Cauliflower Sauce)
steps: Simmer cauliflower with garlic in broth 12 minutes; blend with milk, parmesan, nutmeg and salt into a creamy sauce.
Sear chicken pieces in oil; steam broccoli; cook pasta al dente.
Toss everything with the sauce.

name: Jerk Chicken with Cabbage Slaw
steps: Blend jalapeño, green onion, garlic, ginger, spices, tamari, half the lime, oil into a paste; coat chicken 15 minutes.
Grill or roast at 425°F 22 minutes.
Toss cabbage and carrot with yogurt, remaining lime and salt.

name: Chicken Zucchini Poppers
steps: Grate zucchini and squeeze dry; mix with chicken, green onion, cilantro, garlic, cumin and salt.
Form small balls and bake on an oiled sheet at 400°F 18 minutes.
Serve with guacamole.

name: Chicken Souvlaki Plate
steps: Marinate chicken cubes in lemon, oil, garlic, oregano, salt; skewer and grill 10–12 minutes.
Make tzatziki with yogurt, grated cucumber and dill.
Serve with tomato, onion and warm pita halves.

name: Turkey Taco Skillet
steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper in oil; add seasoning.
Add beans, tomatoes and cauliflower rice; simmer 8 minutes.
Top with cheddar, cover to melt; serve with avocado, yogurt and cilantro.

name: Chicken Caprese Skillet
steps: Sear seasoned chicken in oil 5 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté garlic and tomatoes until they burst; add balsamic and spinach.
Return chicken, top with mozzarella; cover 2 minutes; scatter basil.

name: Chicken & Chickpea Tagine
steps: Brown chicken in oil; remove. Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and spices 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, chickpeas, olives, lemon; return chicken; simmer covered 30 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro; serve with cauliflower couscous.

name: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs with Roasted Veggies
steps: Rub chicken with spices, salt and half the oil; air fry at 400°F 18 minutes, flipping once.
Toss vegetables with remaining oil; roast at 425°F 20 minutes.
Serve together.

name: Chicken Pad Thai with Zoodles
steps: Whisk fish sauce, lime, tamari, sweetener.
Stir-fry chicken in oil with garlic; push aside and scramble eggs.
Add zoodles, sauce, sprouts and green onion; toss 2 minutes; top with peanuts, cilantro.

name: Rosemary Garlic Roasted Chicken Legs
steps: Rub chicken with rosemary, garlic, lemon zest, oil and salt.
Roast at 425°F with cauliflower and carrot 40–45 minutes.
Squeeze lemon over before serving.

name: Chicken Fried Cauliflower Rice
steps: Stir-fry diced chicken in avocado oil; remove.
Scramble eggs; add carrot, garlic, ginger, cauliflower rice; stir-fry 5 minutes.
Add peas, chicken, tamari and sesame oil; finish with green onion.

name: Turkey Sloppy Joes on Lettuce
steps: Brown turkey with onion and pepper in oil; add garlic.
Add tomato sauce, paste, vinegar, Dijon, paprika and sweetener; simmer 10 minutes.
Serve on toasted English muffin halves or in lettuce cups.

name: Chicken Florentine
steps: Sear chicken in oil 5 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté garlic and sun-dried tomatoes; add broth, cream cheese, milk and parmesan; whisk smooth.
Wilt spinach in the sauce, return chicken; simmer 5 minutes.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowls
steps: Season chicken with chili powder, cumin, lime; grill and slice.
Mix brown rice and cauliflower rice for a half-carb base.
Bowl rice, beans, chicken, pico, romaine, avocado, cheddar and yogurt.

name: Chicken Vindaloo (Mild)
steps: Blend garlic, ginger, vinegar and spices; marinate chicken 15 minutes.
Sauté onion in oil until golden; add chicken and marinade; cook 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes and cauliflower; simmer covered 25 minutes; top with cilantro.

name: Chicken Cordon Bleu (Baked, No Breading)
steps: Butterfly chicken, spread Dijon, layer ham and Swiss; roll and secure.
Sprinkle with almond flour-parmesan; bake at 400°F 25–28 minutes.
Serve with roasted asparagus.

name: Turkey Zucchini Meatloaf
steps: Mix turkey, grated squeezed zucchini, onion, eggs, almond flour, garlic, parmesan, seasoning, salt.
Shape into a loaf; spread with tomato paste mixed with Dijon.
Bake at 375°F 50–55 minutes to 165°F; rest 10 minutes.

name: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
steps: Marinate chicken strips in coconut milk, curry powder, turmeric, garlic and half the tamari 20 minutes; skewer.
Grill 4–5 minutes per side.
Whisk peanut butter, remaining tamari, lime, sriracha and warm water; serve with cucumber.

name: Chicken Kale Sausage Skillet with White Beans
steps: Brown sausage slices in oil; add onion and garlic.
Add kale and broth; cook until wilted.
Stir in beans, pepper flakes, lemon; top with parmesan.

name: Chicken Tinga Tostadas (Low-Carb)
steps: Poach chicken and shred. Blend tomatoes, chipotle, sautéed onion and garlic; simmer with chicken 10 minutes.
Bake tortillas at 400°F 8 minutes until crisp.
Top with beans, tinga, lettuce, cotija, avocado and yogurt.

name: Chicken with Creamy Mushroom Sauce
steps: Sear chicken in oil; remove. Sauté mushrooms, shallot, garlic and thyme 6 minutes.
Add broth; reduce; stir in yogurt and Dijon off the heat.
Return chicken; serve with green beans.

name: Greek Turkey Meatballs with Cucumber Salad
steps: Mix turkey, feta, onion, garlic, oregano, mint, egg, almond flour, salt; form 16 meatballs.
Bake at 400°F 18 minutes.
Serve with cucumber-tomato salad and yogurt-dill sauce.

name: Chicken & Asparagus Sheet Pan with Lemon
steps: Toss chicken and vegetables with oil, garlic, seasoning, salt; arrange on a sheet pan with lemon slices.
Roast at 425°F 22 minutes.
Sprinkle with parmesan.

name: Turkey & Spinach Stuffed Portobellos
steps: Brush caps with oil; roast 8 minutes.
Brown turkey with onion, garlic, seasoning; add spinach and marinara.
Fill caps, top with mozzarella; bake at 400°F 12 minutes.

name: Butter Chicken (Lightened)
steps: Marinate chicken in half the yogurt and spices; broil 8 minutes.
Cook onion, ginger, garlic in butter; add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes; blend.
Add coconut milk, remaining yogurt and chicken; simmer 8 minutes; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Chicken Pesto Zucchini Lasagna
steps: Slice zucchini lengthwise; salt and blot dry 15 minutes; grill briefly.
Brown chicken; mix with marinara. Mix ricotta, egg, pesto, spinach.
Layer zucchini, ricotta and chicken sauce; top with mozzarella and parmesan; bake at 375°F 40 minutes.

name: Mustard Glazed Chicken Thighs
steps: Whisk mustards, vinegar, garlic, sweetener, oil and thyme.
Coat chicken and roast at 425°F 25–28 minutes, basting once.
Serve with green beans.

name: Cashew Chicken
steps: Toss chicken with arrowroot; stir-fry in avocado oil; remove.
Stir-fry vegetables, garlic, ginger 4 minutes; add tamari, vinegar, sesame oil.
Return chicken with cashews; serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Chicken Quinoa Stuffed Peppers
steps: Halve peppers; roast 10 minutes.
Brown chicken with onion, garlic, cumin; stir in quinoa, tomatoes and spinach.
Fill peppers, top with cheddar; bake at 400°F 20 minutes.

name: Chicken Gyros with Low-Carb Pita
steps: Marinate chicken in half the yogurt, garlic, oregano, lemon, oil, salt; roast at 450°F 20 minutes; slice.
Mix remaining yogurt with grated cucumber and dill.
Fill warm tortillas with chicken, tomato, onion and tzatziki.

name: Chicken Fajita Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Boil whole sweet potatoes 20–25 minutes until tender (boiling keeps the GI far lower than baking).
Sauté chicken strips, pepper and onion with seasoning in oil.
Split potatoes, fill with fajita mix; top with cheddar, yogurt, cilantro, lime.

name: Turkey Bolognese over Spaghetti Squash
steps: Halve squash, roast cut-side down at 400°F 40 minutes; scrape strands.
Brown turkey with onion, carrot, celery, garlic; add wine, tomatoes, seasoning; simmer 25 minutes; stir in milk.
Serve sauce over squash with parmesan.

name: Chicken Tenders with Buffalo Cauliflower
steps: Coat chicken strips in egg then almond flour-paprika; bake at 425°F 18 minutes.
Toss cauliflower in oil; roast 20 minutes; toss in hot sauce and butter.
Mix yogurt and blue cheese; serve with celery.

name: One-Pot Chicken, Kale & Farro
steps: Sear chicken in oil; remove. Sauté onion and garlic; add cooked farro, broth, thyme.
Return chicken, simmer covered 15 minutes.
Stir in kale until wilted; finish with lemon and parmesan.

name: Chicken Lemon Garlic Zoodle Bowl
steps: Sear chicken pieces in oil with garlic; remove.
Sauté tomatoes 2 minutes; add zoodles, lemon zest and juice; toss 2 minutes.
Return chicken; top with parmesan, basil, pepper flakes.

name: Chicken Cauliflower Fried Rice with Kimchi
steps: Stir-fry chicken in avocado oil until browned.
Add garlic, kimchi, cauliflower rice; cook 5 minutes; push aside and scramble eggs.
Stir in tamari, gochujang, sesame oil, green onion.

name: Crispy Baked Chicken Thighs with Roasted Cabbage
steps: Rub chicken with paprika, garlic powder, salt and half the oil.
Cut cabbage into wedges, brush with oil, Dijon and vinegar.
Roast everything at 425°F 35–40 minutes.

name: Chicken Tostada Salad Bowl with Refried Beans
steps: Season chicken; sear and slice.
Bake tortillas until crisp.
Layer beans, romaine, chicken, pico, cotija, avocado and yogurt over the tortillas.

name: Mediterranean Chicken Thighs with Olives & Artichokes
steps: Sear chicken in oil; add garlic, artichokes, olives, tomatoes, lemon slices, oregano.
Roast at 400°F 25 minutes.
Top with feta and parsley.

name: Peruvian-Style Roast Chicken with Green Sauce
steps: Rub chicken with cumin, paprika, garlic, lime, oil and salt; roast at 425°F 30 minutes.
Blend yogurt, cilantro, jalapeño, mayo and lime into green sauce.
Serve chicken with sauce and romaine.

name: Chicken & Black Bean Quesadillas
steps: Mix chicken, beans, pepper and cumin.
Fill half of each tortilla with cheese and filling; fold.
Cook in oil 3 minutes per side; serve with salsa and yogurt.

name: Chicken & Spinach Stuffed Chicken Breast
steps: Cut pockets in chicken; fill with wilted spinach, cream cheese, mozzarella, garlic, sun-dried tomato.
Season, sear in oil 3 minutes per side; bake at 400°F 18 minutes.
Serve with roasted broccoli.

name: Chicken Yakitori Skewers
steps: Simmer tamari, vinegar, ginger, garlic, sweetener into a glaze.
Skewer chicken and green onion pieces; grill 10–12 minutes, brushing with glaze.
Serve with sautéed bok choy and sesame seeds.

name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Cauliflower Casserole
steps: Steam cauliflower 5 minutes; cook and dice chicken; crisp bacon.
Mix yogurt, cream cheese and ranch; fold in chicken and cauliflower.
Top with cheddar and bacon; bake at 375°F 20 minutes; add green onion.

name: Sesame Ginger Chicken Lettuce Cups
steps: Brown chicken in avocado oil with ginger and garlic.
Add tamari, vinegar, sesame oil and grated carrot; cook 2 minutes.
Serve in lettuce cups with cucumber, green onion and sesame.

name: Chicken Provençal
steps: Sear chicken in oil; remove. Sauté shallot and garlic; add wine.
Add tomatoes, olives, herbs, zucchini; return chicken.
Simmer covered 25 minutes.

name: BBQ Chicken Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Boil whole sweet potatoes 20–25 minutes until tender (boiling keeps the GI far lower than baking).
Simmer tomato paste, vinegar, paprika, sweetener, Dijon and 60 ml water into BBQ sauce; toss with chicken.
Split potatoes, fill with chicken; top with slaw mixed with yogurt and green onion.

name: Chicken Tandoori with Cucumber Raita
steps: Marinate chicken in 150 g yogurt, spices, ginger, garlic, lemon, salt for 30 minutes.
Roast at 450°F 22 minutes.
Mix remaining yogurt with grated cucumber, mint for raita.

name: Crispy Chicken Thighs with Brussels & Bacon
steps: Season chicken; sear skin-side down in an ovenproof skillet 6 minutes.
Add halved sprouts, chopped bacon, garlic; roast at 425°F 25 minutes.
Toss sprouts with vinegar and Dijon.

name: Chicken Paprikash (Yogurt)
steps: Brown chicken in oil; remove. Sauté onion and pepper; add paprika, garlic, tomato paste.
Add broth and chicken; simmer covered 25 minutes.
Stir in yogurt off heat; serve over cauliflower rice with parsley.

name: Chicken Zucchini Noodle Pad See Ew
steps: Stir-fry chicken and garlic in oil; push aside and scramble eggs.
Add broccolini 2 minutes; add zoodles, tamari, fish sauce, sweetener.
Toss 2 minutes; finish with pepper.

name: Turkey Cutlets with Sage & Lemon
steps: Pound turkey cutlets thin; season; sear in oil 3 minutes per side.
Add butter, sage, garlic, broth, lemon juice; simmer 2 minutes.
Serve over sautéed spinach.

name: Chicken Cauliflower Curry Bowl
steps: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger and curry powder in oil.
Add chicken, cauliflower, chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk; simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in spinach; garnish cilantro.

name: Turkey Sausage & Peppers Skillet
steps: Brown sausage in oil; remove.
Sauté peppers, onion, garlic 8 minutes; add tomatoes and seasoning.
Return sausage; simmer 5 minutes; top with parmesan and basil.
